testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel the first save while closing an unsaved part: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-tabs-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:123:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel the first save while closing an unsaved part ✔ Given the user creates a new unsaved metric part, starts a sketch on its XY plane and finishes the sketch ✔ And save-change prompts are configured to always show ✔ When the user clicks the close button on the part's document tab ✔ Then a save-changes prompt identifies the part ✔ When the user chooses Yes to save changes ✔ Then a Save As dialog opens with a suggested file name ✔ When the user cancels the Save As dialog ✔ Then the part remains open and active ✔ And its sketch remains listed in the model browser
